_about: Wordings that say the same thing, read as one when configured phrases are matched
(owner, 2026-10-23: 'use the modern method so this kind of issue does not come').
Terminology is configuration (35.4, as amended by AB-104): this table is the ONE
place equivalences live, applied identically to the contract's text and to every
configured phrase, so a standard written 'remedy such default within' also reads
'remedy it within'. Grammar only: never a party name (in a vendor agreement
LeapSwitch is the buyer, so 'buyer' cannot mean 'customer'), never a legal term
of art, never a figure. Quotes shown to a reader stay the document's own words.
'capped at' reads as 'is limited to' — never the bare 'limited to', which 'including but not limited to' contains.

variants: after the end of the term
after the expiry of the term
after the expiration of the term
